Subject: Outage during 09:00 PST high-throughput window — need SLA confirmation and credit path

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

We saw a significant spike in 503/500 responses on FinFlow from ~09:02–09:43 PST this morning while running our morning settlement batch. Successful throughput dropped ~72% for ~40 minutes; our internal charts and client retries show increased latencies and a notable number of failed transactions.

Can Redwood confirm whether this constitutes a downtime window for SLA purposes and whether FinFlow is eligible for a proportional credit? We urgently need:
- Confirmed start/end times according to Redwood telemetry
- Any immediate mitigation steps we should take to prevent recurrence this week (we're in a critical settlement period)
- ETA for RCAs and whether a post-incident call can be scheduled tomorrow

I've attached a small sample of our traces and our support ticket reference in case it helps (attached: support_ticket_12487.pdf).

Thanks — this is high priority on our side.

Tania Lopez
Head of Ops, FinFlow

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-11-04T15:40:03-07:00
Subject: Preliminary findings and next steps (INC-12487)

Preliminary triage notes for INC-12487:
- Correlated edge and serving logs for the FinFlow request-ids provided. Our telemetry shows a sustained elevation in 5xx rates starting 2027-11-04T09:01:58-07:00 and normalizing ~2027-11-04T09:44:10-07:00 (US-west).
- Early signal points to coordinated KV cache evictions during a concurrent autoscaler downscale event — eviction churn increased tail latencies which cascaded into request timeouts and 503s under the settlement batch pattern.
- No full region outage: the issue was localized to a subset of serving groups handling the FinFlow tenant weight during the batch.

Proposed next steps:
1) Produce a short evidence bundle (SLO timeline CSV, raw traces) by 11/05 10:00 PST.
2) Complete a technical RCA draft and customer-facing summary by 11/06 17:00 PST.
3) Compute a provisional proportional credit using our standard availability apportionment; will need FinFlow to confirm impacted tenant list to finalize numbers.

Please advise if you'd like an earlier postmortem call — I can schedule a 45-minute session tomorrow morning to walk through the initial traces.

—Marcus Lin
Runtime Reliability, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
